amikuk: A skinless creature of glistening raw red muscle with FOUR LONG POWERFUL ARMS, and BELOW THE ARMS ITS BODY NARROWS INTO ONE SMOOTH TAPERING EEL-LIKE TAIL that ends in a point - it has NO legs, NO hips, NO feet, the lower body is a single smooth boneless tail. Its head is a SMOOTH BLANK DOME with no eyes, no nose and no mouth. Arms splayed as if swimming. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bultungin: A person caught HALFWAY through changing into a hyena, split down the middle: the LEFT half of the face is still an ordinary human man with skin and a human eye, and the RIGHT half is spotted hyena fur with a hyena eye and muzzle. One arm is a human arm with a human hand, the other is a furred foreleg with a clawed paw. A blacksmith's scorched leather apron. The transformation caught mid-way and obviously incomplete. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
domovoi: A tiny old HUMAN MAN the size of a cat - completely human with NO fur, NO whiskers, NO animal ears, NO tail, NO cat features of any kind. He is nearly buried in an ENORMOUS BUSHY GREY HUMAN BEARD reaching to his feet, with a bald wrinkled human forehead and bright shrewd human eyes. A scrap of red cloth for a tunic, bare human hands holding a crust of bread. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
huldra: A young woman in a woollen dress seen FROM DIRECTLY BEHIND, with a LONG COW'S TAIL hanging below her skirt. HER ENTIRE BACK IS MISSING AND OPEN: a large hollow cavity where her back should be, its rim ragged like broken bark and its inside dark rotten wood and empty space, exactly like looking into a hollow tree trunk. She glances back over her shoulder. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
jengu: A water spirit with dark brown skin and very long thick wavy black hair, HER MOUTH OPEN IN A WIDE WARM SMILE SHOWING A LARGE OBVIOUS DARK GAP BETWEEN HER TWO FRONT TEETH, a blue and silver fish tail from the waist down, cowrie shells woven into her hair, kind and healing rather than alluring. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
jorogumo: A woman from the waist up joined to A VERY LARGE BULBOUS SPIDER ABDOMEN as big as her whole torso, boldly striped in BRIGHT YELLOW AND BLACK BANDS like a golden orb-weaver, with EIGHT LONG BANDED BLACK-AND-YELLOW SPIDER LEGS arching high above and around her. The spider half dominates the image. A patterned kimono on the human half, silk trailing. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
kamapuaa: An enormous black boar in FULL SIDE PROFILE so all its legs can be counted: EIGHT STOUT LEGS along its body in a row, four front and four rear, every one visible. On its face, EIGHT EYES arranged in two neat rows of four. Bristled shoulders, upcurved white tusks, torn fern caught in its coarse black coat. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
kasaobake: An old torn paper umbrella creature. Its canopy has ONE LARGE EYE in the centre and a wide grinning mouth with a LONG RED TONGUE hanging out. Below the canopy is THE UMBRELLA'S SINGLE WOODEN SHAFT, which ends in ONE BARE FOOT in a wooden sandal. It has NO arms, NO hands, and only THAT ONE LEG - there is nothing else protruding from the umbrella at all. Hopping. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
knocker: An ANCIENT WIZENED MINER THE SIZE OF A SMALL DOLL, tiny and gnome-like with a deeply wrinkled nut-brown face, an enormous bulbous nose and a straggly white beard down his chest. A soft battered leather cap with A LIT CANDLE STUB STUCK TO THE FRONT WITH CLAY. Rough patched 1800s work clothes grey with coal dust. He holds a miner's pick THAT IS AS TALL AS HE IS. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
likho: A tall skeletally gaunt figure in ragged black cloth with EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LARGE EYE set in the middle of a smooth hollow bony face - NO second eye and NO empty socket where one would be, just blank bone to either side of the one eye. Long grasping bony fingers, hunched forward, grinding and miserable. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
lusca: An ENORMOUS ancient octopus filling the whole frame, thick muscular arms as heavy as tree trunks coiling outward with rows of pale suckers, a vast mottled rust-brown and grey mantle, and ONE GREAT COLD STARING EYE. Menacing and immense in scale, arms rising out of black water. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
mapinguari: A huge shaggy red-brown GIANT GROUND SLOTH rearing on its hind legs, ENORMOUS LONG CURVED CLAWS on its forelimbs, thick plated armoured hide, ONE SINGLE EYE in the middle of its face, and A LARGE OPEN FANGED MOUTH SET INTO THE MIDDLE OF ITS BELLY, open and roaring - the belly mouth clearly visible with teeth and a tongue. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
medjed: A simple figure entirely COVERED BY A PLAIN WHITE CLOTH that hangs straight to the floor, with only TWO SMALL ROUND STARING EYES on the cloth and TWO BARE HUMAN FEET sticking out at the bottom. Drawn FLAT AND SIMPLE IN THE STYLE OF AN ANCIENT EGYPTIAN PAPYRUS PAINTING - plain outlines, flat colour, no shading, no folds, no drama. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
nanaue: A powerfully built Hawaiian man seen STRICTLY FROM BEHIND, his bare back fully toward the viewer, a cloak fallen away from his shoulders. SET INTO THE MIDDLE OF HIS UPPER BACK, BETWEEN HIS SHOULDER BLADES, IS AN ENORMOUS OPEN SHARK'S MOUTH lined with rows of white triangular teeth, opening out of his back. His chest is NOT visible. He turns his human face to look back over one shoulder. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
nasnas: EXACTLY ONE HALF OF A MAN, sliced cleanly from the crown of the head straight down through the middle of the body. Only the LEFT half exists: one arm, one leg, half a head with one eye, half a nose, half a mouth. Where the right half should be there is NOTHING AT ALL - open empty air, and the cut face of the body is a FLAT SMOOTH CROSS-SECTION. He balances hopping on his single foot, half a robe hanging from the half a shoulder. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
penghou: A PLAIN GLOSSY BLACK DOG WITH NO TAIL AT ALL - a smooth rounded rump with nothing behind it - ordinary in build and size, SITTING INSIDE THE HOLLOW OF A SPLIT OPEN TREE TRUNK, the pale raw wood of the split curving around and framing it, the dog filling most of the opening. A mild puzzled expression. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
pincoya: A sea spirit whose hair is LONG THICK STRANDS OF GREEN AND GOLDEN SEAWEED AND KELP full of small shells, wearing a rough dress woven from kelp fronds, DANCING BAREFOOT ON WET SAND with both arms raised and her face turned away toward the open sea. Skin faintly luminous, sea spray around her ankles. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
redcap: A squat powerful OLD GOBLIN with WRINKLED GREY-GREEN SKIN, a long hooked nose, sunken red eyes and long lank grey hair, wearing HEAVY BLACK IRON BOOTS with buckles, and A KNITTED WOOLLEN CAP STAINED DARK RUSTY RED WITH DRIED BLOOD. He carries a long iron-headed pikestaff. Long yellow talons on his hands. Old and wizened, not young or muscular. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
shahmaran: Shahmaran: a crowned woman from the waist up, and from the waist down a long thick serpent body coiled beneath her. RISING FROM THE COILS OF THAT SERPENT BODY ARE SEVERAL SMALL SNAKE HEADS on slender necks, each with open mouth and flicking tongue, growing directly out of her own coils. A tall jewelled crown and headdress. Flat bright Anatolian folk-art style. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
snallygaster: A half-bird half-reptile with wide LEATHERY BAT WINGS spread, a LONG POINTED BEAK MADE OF GLEAMING GREY METAL LINED WITH SHARP TEETH, and EXACTLY ONE LARGE EYE IN THE CENTRE OF ITS FOREHEAD with smooth scaled skin where other eyes would be. SEVERAL LONG OCTOPUS TENTACLES TRAIL DOWN FROM ITS CHEST AND BELLY. Mottled grey-green hide. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
soucouyant: An old woman mid-transformation. THE SKIN HAS BEEN PEELED COMPLETELY OFF HER BODY exposing glistening red muscle and sinew from the neck down, and SHE HOLDS THE EMPTY LIMP HUMAN SKIN DRAPED OVER ONE FOREARM like a discarded coat, its hands and face hanging loose. Her head and shoulders burn away into orange flame. Rising into the air. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
tiyanak: A creature with THE BODY AND PROPORTIONS OF A REAL HUMAN BABY - chubby short limbs, rolls of baby fat, a large round head, a bald soft skull - lying on its back with both arms reaching up to be picked up. But its mouth is FULL OF LONG SHARP NEEDLE TEETH and its eyes GLOW RED. It is unmistakably an infant, which is what makes it wrong. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
tupilaq: A small grotesque creature CRUDELY LASHED TOGETHER OUT OF MISMATCHED ANIMAL PARTS THAT DO NOT BELONG TOGETHER - a seal's skull for a head, one bird wing, one seal flipper, a fish tail, human finger bones for claws - the joints BOUND WITH VISIBLE SINEW CORD AND GUT LASHINGS, lopsided and badly made, as if assembled in a hurry by hand. Yellowed bone and dried hide. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
veli: A small slender Fijian forest child-spirit with dark brown skin and A CLEARLY VISIBLE FACE - large dark eyes, a gentle watchful expression, the whole face unobstructed. On top of the head sits A MODEST CIRCLET OF GREEN LEAVES AND SMALL FLOWERS, sitting above the brow and not covering the face or dominating the figure. Holding a sprig of a plant protectively. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
zduhac: The spirit of a BEARDED SERBIAN PEASANT FARMER wearing a LOOSE ROUGH HOMESPUN LINEN SHIRT AND COARSE WOOLLEN TROUSERS with a wide sash - old-fashioned nineteenth-century village clothing, absolutely NO modern shirt, NO jeans, NO belt buckle - rising into a storm with both arms raised, HIS LEGS AND LOWER BODY DISSOLVING INTO SWIRLING GREY STORM CLOUD, lightning crackling from his hands. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
